verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents first-party tool/function calling using OpenAI-compatible tool specifications, explicitly for building agents that call APIs and take actions. It also offers JSON-schema and grammar-constrained structured outputs that support reliable parsing. The evidence does not show parallel tool calls, multi-step tool loops, or any measure of how faithfully tool calls work on open models. Missing for 10: documented parallel tool calling, documented multi-step/agent-loop tool use, per-model tool-calling support details, independent or hands-on corroboration of tool-call reliability.
